findings.claim: Provider address. The plan now adds `service "seaweedfs" { policy = "read" }` to the deploy policy in bootstrap/playbooks/enable_consul_secrets.yml and runs the playbook before the first apply. The policy already grants `node_prefix ""` read, which the lookup needs for node_address. The playbook is a standalone step in bootstrap/justfile and is safe to re-run (consul_policy updates in place; the other tasks are guarded or rewrite the same config). minio-removal plans the same edit-and-run for this file.

Backup key placement. The applications root now creates the backup user and writes `default/backup-minio/seaweedfs`. The deployer Vault policy grants create/update on `secret/data/default/*` (deployments/infrastructure/identity.tf:458), and the applications root already writes under that prefix. The job is `job "backup-minio"`, so the nomad-workloads policy (secret/data/<namespace>/<job_id>/*) lets it read the new path at run time. The rebuild ordering gap is stated and accepted in the plan.
